title: Fractions

scenes.t: A fraction is a part of a whole that is cut into EQUAL parts. The bottom number (denominator) tells how many parts; the top (numerator) tells how many we take.
One half (½) is 1 of 2 equal parts. One quarter (¼) is 1 of 4 equal parts. One third (⅓) is 1 of 3 equal parts.
To find a fraction of an amount, divide. Omar has 24 beads and ½ are black: 24 ÷ 2 = 12. A quarter of 8 sweets is 8 ÷ 4 = 2.
Equivalent fractions are equal: ½ = 2/4 = 4/8, and 2/5 = 4/10. Multiply top and bottom by the same number.
When the bottoms are the same, add the tops: 1/3 + 2/3 = 3/3 = 1 whole. And 2/7 + 5/7 = 1.
3 whole pizzas and a quarter is a mixed number: 3¼. On a number line, 1¾ is between 1 and 2, three quarters of the way.
One tenth means divide by 10. One tenth of 90 = 9.

items.a: Part of a whole cut into equal parts.
The top number: parts we take.
The bottom number: total equal parts.
A whole number and a fraction: 3¼.

why.h: Half the equal parts are shaded.
